briefing_authority.name: Dr. Kirk Maxwell

dialogue.intro: My name is Dr. Kirk Maxwell. Should any of you become recurring expedition personnel, we'll be seeing quite a bit of one another.
dialogue.mission_statement: Today's assignment is straightforward. Delivery and introductory reconnaissance.
dialogue.roster_call: {coworker2_name} has custody of the startup material scheduled for Outpost A, Bermuda branch. {player_name}, you're on camera. {coworker3_name}, layout record. {coworker1_name}, observation and verbal recall.
dialogue.dismissal: There isn't time for questions here. Get acquainted, then report to Equipment Staging.

briefing_authority.threshold_sendoff: Proceed with a radio check upstairs, and they'll clear you. Nothing you haven't done before. Enter, remember what you see, drop the bag, be home before the streetlights come on. Godspeed, kids.

mission.rationale: ASYNC requires delivery of startup prerequisite materials to Outpost A (Bermuda branch) and introductory field reconnaissance with return by 12:00 noon.

site.label: Outpost A, Bermuda branch via the KV31 Threshold route
site.knowledge_status: Outpost A established as a forward bastion along the guidance path; layout requires physical delivery

mission.primary: Enter the Complex, reach Outpost A (Bermuda branch), deliver the assigned startup prerequisite materials, and return through KV31 by 12:00.
procedures: Report to Equipment Staging and verify manifest.
Proceed to KV31 Threshold Chamber and perform Standard radio check.
Follow the physical neon-green guidance tape to Outpost A.
Deliver the startup prerequisite materials at Outpost A.
Return to KV31, verify return with Control Room surveillance, and cross back to Standard before 12:00.

guidance.description: thick neon-green tape with directional arrows

control_room_surveillance.operator_message: I've got you from here. I'm logging the return this time. Don't count on somebody having eyes on you next time.
